name: NPM or Yarn install with caching

working-directory.description: Working directory to specify subfolder in which dependencies are defined

useLockFile.description: Option to enable or disable use of a lock file (package-lock.json/yarn.lock)

useRollingCache.description: Option to enable restoring a cache that doesn't exactly match the lockfile, and expire once a month to keep it from only growing larger

cache-key-prefix.description: Prefix the cache name with this string
